description: This file defines a React functional component named AdminPage, which provides an admin dashboard interface in a frontend application. It includes features for displaying admin overview stats, creating announcements, managing announcements, and reviewing moderation queue. The component interacts with an API ('demoApi') and utilizes context ('useUI') for user interface interactions.
